🏮 a winter project for Martha's Vineyard

Aquickah

Rides, meals, favors, and warmth — a private, neighbor-to-neighbor network built to make this island's winter a little less lonely.

⛵ rides · deliveries · favors

Ask the neighborhood

Need a ride off the ferry with your hands full of firewood? Someone to watch the chickens over Thanksgiving? Post it to the Feed, and earn Hearth Points for showing up when a neighbor needs you.

🔨 the grange

Turn a side project into a living

Post what you're building — a hot sauce recipe, a mending business, a boat you're restoring. Flag it as a budding venture and watch it move from Seed to Harvest as neighbors back it, offer a skill, or leave a testimonial.

🏮 the lantern list

Nobody has to spend the holidays alone

An opt-in list for neighbors who'd welcome company this season. Light a lantern for someone — a dinner invite, a porch visit, nothing fancy — and you both earn the season's highest Hearth Points.

⚓ built by neighbors, for neighbors

No corporate app store. No ads. Just the island taking care of its own this winter.

A proof of concept — still finding its feet, same as everyone does their first season back.
